name: Treshala's Pendant
summary: In Razorfen Kraul, Heralath's pendant bears the bond he shares with Treshala. He carried it from their home in Darnassus into southern Kalimdor, where the quilboar tore it from him as he lay dying.

sections.title: Token of Devotion
sections.body: On perilous journeys from Teldrassil, Heralath Fallowbrook kept the pendant close. It brought his home to mind, along with his beloved wife, Treshala, and the devotion they shared.

sections.title: Lost in the Briars
sections.body: Heralath entered Razorfen Kraul with his party, where savage quilboar fell upon them. As he lay dying, one of the tusked defenders tore away his pendant. Heralath asked a passing adventurer to wrest the keepsake from his killers and carry it home to Treshala in Darnassus, with news of his fate.

faq.answer: Treshala Fallowbrook owns the pendant. Her husband Heralath carried it as a keepsake of their union before he died in Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: How did the pendant end up in Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Heralath Fallowbrook carried the pendant on an expedition into Razorfen Kraul. After quilboar ambushed and mortally wounded him, one took the necklace from him.

faq.q: Who asks for the pendant to be recovered?
faq.answer: As he lies dying in Razorfen Kraul, Heralath Fallowbrook begs passing adventurers to recover the pendant and return it to his wife in Darnassus with news of his death.

faq.q: Who receives the pendant once it is recovered?
aliases: where do i take the pendant
faq.answer: Treshala Fallowbrook receives the recovered pendant. Heralath's widow lives in Darnassus, the night elf capital atop Teldrassil.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can honor a fellow kaldorei who perished far from Teldrassil's shelter by recovering the pendant.
As an Alliance member, you can carry the token to Darnassus and bring comfort to a widow mourning her fallen explorer.
